en: Black‑and‑white rural scene showing an old water mill complex beside a narrow mill stream. Several wooden and half‑timbered buildings with steep shingled roofs stand among large trees. Water is visibly cascading from a sluice or waterwheel area into the channel. In the foreground are a grassy lawn and a wildflower meadow bordered by bushes and trees. The overall style evokes an early‑20th‑century European countryside. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image.
